name: app
title: app
description:
Create a Daily Mood Logger micro-app using FastAPI. 
- Should let the user select mood (Happy, Sad, Angry, Calm, etc.)
- Add an optional note for each entry
- Store entries in memory or a simple JSON file
- Display the last 5 mood entries on the homepage
- Include a “Clear Logs” button
